title: Y--McGee Creek Natural Scenic Recreation Area (NSRA) Improvements
description: The Bureau of Reclamation is conducting market research for the McGee Creek Natural Scenic Recreation Area (NSRA) Improvements Project in Oklahoma. The project includes demolition of existing facilities and construction of a new shower/restroom building, group shelter, ADA-accessible recreation amenities, parking improvements, utility installations (water, sewer, and electrical), site grading, drainage, erosion control, and restoration.   Interested contractors are encouraged to review the attached Sources Sought Notice for the complete project description, requested information, and submission instructions.
